 Unit Spec Custimization 
Now you can custumize all unit specs with a sipmle .csv file. You can find the default file from:

DEFAULT UNIT SPECS EXCEL FILE

All you have to do is:
- Download xlsx file
- Edit values as you want
- Save it as .csv file format as "unit_specs.csv" (NAME IS IMPORTANT. MAKE EXACTLY SAME)
- Put the "unit_specs.csv" file to in Field of Honors location in steamapps folder:
\Field of Honor\Field Of Honor_Data\Resources\Mods\
If "Mods" folder does not exist, create it. Game will automatically load  unit_specs.csv. If you want to return default you can just delete the "unit_specs.csv" file.

A video tutorial is here:
[previewyoutube=MMweFSfSrL0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: v0.40.0
notes.content:
New Units
New infantry units:

 France: National Guards

 Austria: Landwehr

Building Mechanics
Now you can build different fortifications and improve your gameplay.

[previewyoutube=lfi7LdY7w44;full][/previewyoutube]


 Fortifications can be destroyed by artillery fire.
 Fortifications can slow the enemy and break their lines.
 Both enemy and ally AI can also build fortifications automatically. But you can disable this behaviour from advanced settings and in game AI control menu.
 In conquest mode you can only build them when you have a near unit.

Other New

 New map for Assault/Defence mode: Winter Heights
 You can adjust blood staying time.
 "Enormous" resource option for custom game mode.

Bug Fixes & Optimizations

 Fixed units looking wrong direction problem that happens in conquest mode.
 Units was just waiting on spawn positions and not moving sometimes.
 Some translations fixes.
 Artillery wheel was not turning while moving.
 Artillery was shooting by itself sometimes, even when all crew is dead
 Fixed extreme performance problem when too many artillery in use.
 Some maps commanding image were wrong. They are updated.
 Dead body stay time setting is moved to "Settings" menu from "Advanced"
 Removed wrong 1600x24 resolution from video settings.
 Fixed some units hats are not visible even in close distances.
